title: HelpMeOut: A Neuropsychology-Grounded Benchmark for Error-Aware Monitoring of Household Task Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.17694v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce HelpMeOut, an embodied AI benchmark for error-aware monitoring of household task execution. Existing embodied household benchmarks typically assume that humans execute tasks correctly, but this assumption does not hold for cognitively impaired persons or older adults whose everyday activities produce structured execution errors. To address this gap, HelpMeOut operationalizes research on everyday action errors into 20000 paired activity episodes, covering nine neuropsychologically motivated error categories. In each episode, agents observe a streaming human activity trajectory and must monitor whether the execution is unfolding correctly, diagnosing any structured errors as early as possible. We evaluate learned-monitor, symbolic, change-point, and frontier LLM prompting baselines. Results show that these methods perform poorly as error monitors, often missing when execution goes wrong. translated_title: HelpMeOut：一个基于神经心理学的家务任务执行错误感知监控基准
translated_abstract: 我们提出了HelpMeOut，这是一个用于家务任务执行错误感知监控的具身智能基准。现有的具身家务基准通常假设人类能够正确执行任务，但这一假设对于认知障碍人士或老年人并不成立，因为他们的日常活动会产生结构化的执行错误。为弥补这一空白，HelpMeOut将关于日常动作错误的研究成果转化为20000个成对活动片段，涵盖九种基于神经心理学的错误类别。在每个片段中，智能体观察人类活动的流式轨迹，必须监控任务执行是否正确进行，并尽早诊断出任何结构化错误。我们评估了学习型监控器、符号方法、变点检测以及前沿大语言模型提示等基线方法。结果表明，这些方法作为错误监控器的表现不佳，常常无法察觉执行过程中出现的错误。这些结果表明了此类基准所留下的研究空白。
tldr: 本文提出了HelpMeOut——首个基于神经心理学、涵盖九类结构化错误和20000对活动片段的具身AI基准，用于家务任务执行的错误感知监控，并揭示了包括前沿大语言模型在内的现有方法均难以胜任这一监控任务。
en_tdlr: HelpMeOut is a neuropsychology-grounded embodied AI benchmark with 20,000 paired activity episodes across nine error categories for error-aware monitoring of household task execution, revealing that existing methods—including frontier LLMs—perform poorly as error monitors.
